sample_unit: clinician responses to suicidal ideation scenarios rated by each LLM (SIRI-2 items)

links.outcome: LLM competency in rating appropriateness of responses to suicidal ideation versus expert suicidologists (SIRI-2)
links.effect: All 3 LLMs rated responses more appropriate than experts (mean diff 0.86 ChatGPT, 0.61 Claude, 0.73 Gemini); outliers 19%, 11%, 36%; Claude and ChatGPT matched or exceeded professionals.
links.quote: Current versions of 3 major LLMs demonstrated an upward bias in their evaluations of appropriate responses to suicidal ideation; however, 2 of the 3 models performed equivalent to or exceeded the performance of mental health professionals.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM competency in rating appropriate clinician responses to suicidal ideation vignettes against expert suicidologists using an automated/standardized benchmarking prompt approach without testing a deployment practice.
